g.text: Paid physicians' GLP-1 prescribing tilted toward the paying brand, except Victoza

text.style: font-size: 9.69px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica Neue', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Change in the paid brand's share of the physician's GLP-1 claims, percentage points, vs the year before the first payment

text.style: font-size: 7.41px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica Neue', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: Physicians already prescribing GLP-1s. Callaway–Sant'Anna doubly robust estimator, not-yet-paid comparison physicians with similar diabetes workload, volume, specialty and region; bands:

text.style: font-size: 7.41px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica Neue', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: 95% CIs clustered by practice; labels: average of years 0–3. Mounjaro measured from its 2022 launch. Victoza's share was already falling before payment. If Medicare's hidden small counts

text.style: font-size: 7.41px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica Neue', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: (0–10 claims) are bounded against the result, the gains shrink to +1.8, +1.7, +1.8 pp. In the pre-registered log-odds form (matched) they are +3.9, +3.1, +5.7 pp, and only Mounjaro

text.style: font-size: 7.41px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica Neue', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: clears zero. Companies also call on doctors when a brand gains a label or formulary position. Shown from 4 years before payment; every year is in report/qa. Associations, not proof that
